lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters across the lateral flank, with more densely packed, smaller-diameter nodes proximal to the gill region transitioning to larger, more widely spaced nodes towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a distinct rectangular lattice pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature across the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, exhibiting high-intensity light reflection on the dorsal-facing edge and immediate shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.
